name: Silversmith Vigdis
title: The Silver Setting
examine: Precise as a hallmark. Her shop gleams the way a drawn blade does, beautifully and on purpose.
lines: The Queen's circlet came off that bench. So did the toll-house seal at the ford. Small work, long memory.
I buy assay-stamped silver only. Runa's stamp or no sale. If someone offers you mountain silver without it, you've met the Rookery.
Balla makes the mountain useful. I make it beautiful. Thirty years we've argued which is harder.
